# Feature 3: soft delete for comments

Scope: comments only. Articles keep their hard delete.

Rules (values are in the sources, not copied here):

1. Delete today: deleteComment, app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts. It removes the row. Feature 3 changes it to a soft delete: the row stays, marked as deleted, and other data is untouched.
2. Comment list filter: getCommentsByArticle, app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts. Deleted comments are left out of its results. Its other filters stay as they are.
3. Comment fields: model Comment in app/src/prisma/schema.prisma, matched by app/src/prisma/migrations/20210924225358_initial/migration.sql. Followed this source over app/src/app/routes/article/comment.model.ts (conflict, see planner report).
4. Deletion marker: none exists in schema.prisma or in any migration. Add one with a new migration.
5. Error shape and status codes: error handler in app/src/main.ts and HttpException in app/src/app/models/http-exception.model.ts. The repo has no written rule for this. New comment errors use the same status codes and body shape as updateComment in app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts (conflict, see planner report).
6. Delete success response: deleteComment route in app/src/app/routes/article/article.controller.ts. Unchanged.

Not used: the RealWorld spec linked in app/README.md. Its THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is not in the working directory.

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider        = "prisma-client-js"
  previewFeatures = []
}

model Article {
  id          Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  slug        String    @unique
  title       String
  description String
  body        String
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  tagList     Tag[]
  author      User      @relation("UserArticles", fields: [authorId], onDelete: Cascade, references: [id])
  authorId    Int
  favoritedBy User[]    @relation("UserFavorites")
  comments    Comment[]
}

model Comment {
  id        Int      @id @default(autoincrement())
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now())
  body      String
  article   Article  @relation(fields: [articleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  articleId Int
  author    User     @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  authorId  Int
}

model Tag {
  id       Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  name     String    @unique
  articles Article[]
}

model User {
  id         Int       @id @default(autoincrement())
  email      String    @unique
  username   String    @unique
  password   String
  image      String?   @default("https://api.realworld.io/images/smiley-cyrus.jpeg")
  bio        String?
  articles   Article[] @relation("UserArticles")
  favorites  Article[] @relation("UserFavorites")
  followedBy User[]    @relation("UserFollows")
  following  User[]    @relation("UserFollows")
  comments   Comment[]
  demo       Boolean   @default(false)
}

The rules are settled. Here is what I'm applying:

- Deletion marker: a nullable `deletedAt DateTime?`. The repo has no existing marker, and `deletedAt` matches the timestamp style of `createdAt` and `updatedAt`.
- Delete: set `deletedAt` only, so the row and its other fields are untouched.
- Lists: exclude rows where `deletedAt` is set.
- Errors: a deleted comment is treated as not found, using `updateComment`'s 404 body.

I'll start with the schema and the migration.

Feature 3 (soft delete for comments) is built, but I could not run the tests or the Prisma steps in this session, so nothing below is verified by execution.

## Answers to the two questions

1. **Deletion and lists (from the repo):** Before this change, `deleteComment` hard-deleted the row with `prisma.comment.delete`. Comment lists come from `getCommentsByArticle`, which returns comments whose author has `demo = true`, plus comments by the caller when they are logged in. Anonymous callers see only demo-author comments.
2. **Error shape (from the repo):** Errors are thrown as `new HttpException(status, body)`. `app/src/main.ts` sends `body` as the raw JSON, with no wrapper. The codes in use are 401, 403, 404, 422 and 500. The repo has no written rule for this. The convention is code-derived: 404 and 422 use `{ errors: { field: [messages] } }`, and 403 uses `{ message }`.

## What changed (all under `app/`)

- `src/prisma/schema.prisma`: added `deletedAt DateTime?` to `Comment`.
- `src/prisma/migrations/20261030120000_comment_soft_delete/migration.sql`: `ALTER TABLE "Comment" ADD COLUMN "deletedAt" TIMESTAMP(3);`
- `src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts`:
  - `deleteComment` now looks up only comments with `deletedAt: null`, then sets `deletedAt` to now. It no longer calls `delete`, and no other field is touched.
  - `getCommentsByArticle` adds `deletedAt: null` next to the existing `OR` author filter.
- `src/tests/services/article.service.test.ts`: added tests for soft delete, the 404 on a missing or already-deleted comment, the list filter, and the mapped list result.

## Rules applied

| Rule | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Delete behavior | Soft delete: row kept, `deletedAt` set, other data untouched | `specs/feature-3-soft-delete.md` rule 1; `deleteComment` in `article.service.ts` |
| List filter | Exclude rows with `deletedAt` set; keep the demo-or-own-id filter | Spec rule 2; `getCommentsByArticle` |
| Comment fields | Matched to `model Comment` in `schema.prisma` and the initial migration | Spec rule 3; `schema.prisma`, `20210924225358_initial/migration.sql` |
| Deletion marker | `deletedAt DateTime?`, a timestamp in the same style as `createdAt` and `updatedAt`. This is my choice; no marker existed | Spec rule 4; no existing marker in schema or migrations |
| Error shape | `HttpException(status, body)`, sent as raw JSON | `src/main.ts`; `src/app/models/http-exception.model.ts` |
| Not-found error | 404 with body `{ errors: { comment: ['not found'] } }` | Spec rule 5; `updateComment` in `article.service.ts` |
| Delete success response | 200 with `{}`, unchanged | Spec rule 6; `deleteComment` route in `article.controller.ts` |

## Issues you need to look at

- **The planner report does not exist.** The spec cites it for two conflicts (rules 3 and 5). I searched the workspace and found nothing. I followed the sources the spec names: `schema.prisma` for fields, and `updateComment` for the error shape.
- **I changed an existing response.** The 404 in `deleteComment` used to return `{}`. It now returns `updateComment`'s body, because a deleted comment is treated as not found, and the spec asks new comment errors to match `updateComment`. Revert this if the `{}` body must stay.
- **Editing a deleted comment is still allowed.** `updateComment` (the uncommitted feature 1 work) does not filter `deletedAt`, so a soft-deleted comment can still be edited. The spec limits this feature to the delete and list code, so I did not change it. The fix is to add `deletedAt: null` to its `findFirst`, and I'd recommend doing that next.
- **The 403 branch in `deleteComment` is unreachable.** The lookup already filters by `author.id`, so a non-owner gets a 404. I left it as it was.
- **Not run:** The tests have not been run. Before running them, run `npx prisma generate` so the client knows `deletedAt`, then `npx prisma migrate deploy` against the database.
- **Uncommitted work:** The feature 1 changes were already uncommitted in the working tree. I built on top of them and did not commit anything.

- **The 403 branch in `deleteComment` is unreachable.** The lookup already filters by `author.id`, so a non-owner gets a 404. I left it as it was.
